title: Fix Missing Blob Param in File Passthrough Component
description: The FileComponent class is missing the blob parameter in its RegisterModelInputParams, RegisterModelOutputParams, GetModelData, and SetModelData methods. The FileDiffComponent has the correct implementation which should be used as a reference.
summary: Added missing blob parameter to FileComponent class in Compose.Grasshopper.cs. The blob parameter was added to RegisterModelInputParams, RegisterModelOutputParams, GetModelData, and SetModelData methods, following the same pattern as FileDiffComponent.
